"""Redis integration tests.

Tests basic Redis operations (SET/GET, TTL, JSON, counters, hashes)
used by the worker queue and caching layers.

Requires: docker compose up redis
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import uuid

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration


class TestRedisIntegration:
    """Tests for Redis integration."""

    def test_redis_set_get(self, redis_client):
        """Can set and get values."""
        key = f"test:{uuid.uuid4()}"
        value = "test_value"

        redis_client.set(key, value)
        result = redis_client.get(key)

        assert result.decode() == value

    def test_redis_expires(self, redis_client):
        """Keys can have TTL."""
        key = f"test:{uuid.uuid4()}"
        value = "expires_soon"

        redis_client.setex(key, 3600, value)
        ttl = redis_client.ttl(key)

        assert ttl > 0
        assert ttl <= 3600

    def test_redis_json(self, redis_client):
        """Can store JSON in Redis."""
        key = f"test:{uuid.uuid4()}"
        data = {"run_id": str(uuid.uuid4()), "status": "RUNNING"}

        redis_client.set(key, json.dumps(data))
        result = json.loads(redis_client.get(key))

        assert result["status"] == "RUNNING"

    def test_redis_increment(self, redis_client):
        """Can increment counters."""
        key = f"counter:{uuid.uuid4()}"

        redis_client.incr(key)
        redis_client.incr(key)
        redis_client.incr(key)

        assert int(redis_client.get(key)) == 3

    def test_redis_hash_operations(self, redis_client):
        """Can use hash operations."""
        key = f"run:{uuid.uuid4()}"

        redis_client.hset(key, mapping={
            "status": "RUNNING",
            "io_count": "0",
            "started_at": "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        })

        status = redis_client.hget(key, "status")
        assert status.decode() == "RUNNING"

        redis_client.hincrby(key, "io_count", 5)
        io_count = redis_client.hget(key, "io_count")
        assert int(io_count) == 5
